scope: Complete Angkor Wat ancient architectural ensemble: five central lotus-bud towers and their tiered sanctuaries; three concentric galleries with native open courts, cruciform connecting galleries, six mapped libraries, bounded intrinsic terraces/stone stairs/paved causeways and naga balustrades; west monumental gopura plus north/east/south outer gates and full native enclosure wall network. Include ancient western bridge/causeway footprint. No natural moat/water/forest/landscape mesh or entire82ha ground slab; modern floating pontoon/access facilities, later separate stupa/monasteries/sculpture collections, neighboring Angkor monuments and people excluded.

quallaSearch.notes: Qualla corpus searched first and actual originals inspected. The 1866 Gsell photo native record explicitly expresses source copyright uncertainty and is unused. Both1906postcard files are their blank backs, and the rough-map alias is a regional map, not a temple survey; unused. Other alleged PD local candidates depict Preah Ko/Srah Srang/Ta Keo rather than Angkor Wat. Modern local full-hall photos are other licensed and unused. Nine exact Balon Greyjoy2019own-work CC0 originals supply the missing current architecture; nativeSHA1 and explicit creator self-release matched, all9originals inspected. No other imagery needed for this scope.
